newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain avg wages rise 3.1 pct in H1-Econ Ministry.
newsitem.headline: Spain avg wages rise 3.1 pct in H1-Econ Ministry.

text.p: The average wage increase in collective agreements during the first half of the year was 3.1 pct, according to Economy Ministry figures published on Tuesday in a monthly report on economic indicators.
The Ministry sees a full-year figure of around three pct, one percentage point below last year's average agreements (3.8 pct or 4.1 pct) depending on revisions included in special safeguard clauses.
"...given the advanced stage of wage negotiations, the average wage increase for the whole year will show a slight fall and eventually grow around three pct", said the Ministry.
